body:
Adds the unchanged pre-Bink build runner and source manifest with concise package documentation, after the contracts and five component packages provide their source closure. Extracts only the original Audio callback-body sharing and guarded facade-compilation changes: legacy callbacks retain their TLS prologues, admitted callback entry points share the file operations, and explicit development compilation can map Audio calls through the facade. Normal game selection remains direct Miles.

**Depends on #31 (native Audio widths), #41 (contracts), and #47–#51 (Miles components).** Only #31 is included in this branch; its Audio.cpp changes are needed by the callback patch. The other component files are not duplicated here. Review the [incremental build/Audio changes](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/compare/0699bd3d9b08998cb731d6ac7655681f3d003e6d...e3cd03947e3a739fa627fc110526be3c1780c3b7): six files, +564/−40. Audio.cpp changes +117/−39, its project header list +2/−1, and four build/documentation files add 445 lines. The master comparison also includes #31.

Composing this branch with the reviewed component prerequisites reproduces the reviewed build/Audio tree exactly. Production and build patches were not changed during this extraction.

The build.py, sources.json and .gitignore blobs match the [pre-selection checkpoint](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/commit/d1c5903de35586dc8cfb0939a5da1756cca43179). Audio/project patches were applied unmodified from [callback extraction](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/commit/4f15b029a8f2d99426f096431f649017168c5a6b) and [guarded facade compilation](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/commit/5c31706581bc93679300bde212d6c9a69cd95690). All 50 manifest source entries and referenced probe/context tests exist. No truncated runner, SDK redistribution, stub or new behavior was introduced during packaging.

This is not a standalone master-based x64 game build. Windows/v120 and the genuine SDK are required. Engine-worker, audio-dev and pipe-probe targets need an external maintained engine checkout with explicit resolved Debug|x64 clientAudio settings and the genuine STLport headers; this branch's project still has only Win32 configurations. Pipe-probe also needs its listed genuine Debug-x64 engine/STLport archives. Native and pipe facades are alternative targets. The receipt enumerates exact prerequisites.

The README was adapted in a documentation-only follow-up: it explains current prerequisites, callback/lifetime contracts and portable commands, states that CI is absent, and links the original checkpoint README for preserved historical outcomes and failures. All other source/build blobs remain unchanged. No builds, tests or runtime were run during packaging. Game backend selection, Bink and Release integration remain later packages.

[Source identities and independent packaging review](https://github.com/Akilleez-QA/client-tools/blob/d75d90b933257a6be51a3870e1d34bd8871f7e30/review/client-x64/pr-ready-next/miles-build-audio/RESULTS.md).
title: Add Miles component build entry points and guarded Audio handoff
